item.title: Selling Stored Power: How US Homes Are Turning Batteries Into Revenue
item.description: In Washington state, home battery owners are discovering that their backup systems can do more than keep the lights on during outages — they can generate a steady income. Puget Sound Energy (PSE) has rolled out its Flex Batteries program, allowing homeowners to enrol their battery systems and get paid for supporting grid stability.
